pricing.title: Quote pricing
pricing.subtitle: These rates are used to calculate instant quotes when you create a job. You can always override the price.

hints.base_fee: Fixed charge for every job (collection, admin).
hints.rate_per_distance: Loaded distance from collection to delivery.
hints.fuel_surcharge_pct: Applied to base fee + distance charge.
hints.adr_surcharge: Added when a job carries dangerous goods.

pricing.fuelNote: Tip: review your fuel surcharge monthly in line with diesel prices.

team.name: Name
team.inviteHint: They'll get a link to join your workspace.
team.roleHint: Drivers only see the driver app. Accountants can manage invoices.
team.removeConfirm: Remove this person from your workspace? They will lose access immediately.
team.limitReached: You've used every seat on your plan.
team.mailSubject: You're invited to join {org} on Haulora
team.mailBody:
Hi,

{org} has invited you to Haulora, our transport management system.

Accept your invitation here: {link}

The link is valid for 7 days.

privacy.residencyBody: Your data is stored in London, United Kingdom, with nightly encrypted backups.
privacy.securityBody: TLS in transit, encrypted at rest, and row-level security so no other company can ever see your data.
privacy.rolesBody: You decide what is processed. Matrix Infotech Ltd acts as your processor under our DPA.
privacy.exportHint: Download everything your company holds in Haulora as a machine-readable JSON file (GDPR Articles 15 & 20).
privacy.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can export company data.

retention.invoices: Invoices are kept for as long as your account exists, so you can meet tax record rules (6 years UK, up to 10 years in some EU countries).
retention.jobs: Jobs, proof-of-delivery signatures and photos are kept until you delete them or close your account.
retention.gps: Driver GPS positions are only recorded while a driver is on shift with location sharing switched on.
retention.checks: Vehicle walkaround checks are kept so you can evidence roadworthiness to the DVSA and other authorities.
retention.audit: The audit log records who changed what, for accountability.
retention.backups: When you delete your company, data is removed immediately and disappears from backups within 14 days.

privacy.legalLinks: Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <dpa>Data Processing Agreement</dpa>.
privacy.dangerHint: These actions are permanent and cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteMeBody: Removes your personal login. Company data you created stays with the company.
privacy.deleteOrgBody: Cancels your subscription and permanently erases all jobs, customers, invoices, drivers, vehicles and files.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: A record of important actions in your workspace.
